mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fish_breakout_score (user_id, best_cleared_pools, best_released_fish, best_mistakes, best_duration, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bestClearedPools}, #{bestReleasedFish}, #{bestMistakes}, #{bestDuration}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE fish_breakout_score SET best_cleared_pools = #{dto.clearedPools}, best_released_fish = #{dto.releasedFish}, best_mistakes = #{dto.mistakes}, best_duration = #{dto.duration}, achieved_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ( best_cleared_pools < #{dto.clearedPools} OR (best_cleared_pools = #{dto.clearedPools} AND best_released_fish < #{dto.releasedFish}) )
mapper.select: SELECT s.best_cleared_pools AS clearedPools, s.best_released_fish AS releasedFish, s.best_mistakes AS mistakes, u.nickname AS nickname FROM fish_breakout_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_cleared_pools DESC, s.best_released_fish DESC, u.nickname ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.best_cleared_pools AS score, s.best_released_fish AS secondaryScore FROM fish_breakout_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_cleared_pools DESC, s.best_released_fish DESC, u.nickname ASC
